# FPDF Installation Instructions

## Download FPDF

1. Visit: http://www.fpdf.org/
2. Download the latest version of FPDF
3. Extract the downloaded archive
4. Create the directory structure: `CardioRisk/vendor/fpdf/`
5. Copy the `fpdf.php` file into `CardioRisk/vendor/fpdf/fpdf.php`

## Alternative: Use this file

If you already have `fpdf.php`, place it here:
`CardioRisk/vendor/fpdf/fpdf.php`

The report module will then work correctly.

## Note

FPDF is a free PHP library for PDF generation. It's lightweight and doesn't require any external dependencies.
